data.animaCaption: Seated by the sunny café window on the left in her Himematsu blazer, Ayachi Nene lifts a spoon over a tall strawberry parfait in delight as Shiki Natsume on the right in her brown suspender café uniform leans gracefully to set down a steaming cup of black tea. Crisp afternoon window light warms the wooden table and porcelain.
data.promptProse: Framed across a sunlit wooden café table displaying a tall strawberry parfait and bone-china teapot in the foreground, Ayachi Nene sits on the left wearing her Himematsu navy blazer and yellow bowtie, lifting a silver spoon with a bright, delighted smile. Standing beside the booth on the right in her Café Stella white shirt, purple ribbon tie, and brown suspender skirt, Shiki Natsume leans slightly forward to place a steaming cup of tea onto the saucer with a dryly amused expression under crisp spring afternoon window light.
data.story: 放学后的星光咖啡馆飘着刚烤好的松饼香。穿着姬松校服的宁宁坐在靠窗位对着草莓圣代眼睛发亮，身穿店员制服的夏目端着红茶弯腰放在桌边，忍不住轻轻挑眉——「慢点吃，又没人跟你抢。这杯红茶配甜点刚好解腻。」
